name: AI-Based Transfer Function Peak Prediction
definition: A React hook that uses a MobileNetV3-Small ONNX neural network running in WebAssembly to automatically predict the optimal `peak` parameter for a volume rendering transfer function by analyzing rendered frames.
summary: AI-Based Transfer Function Peak Prediction automates selecting the optimal opacity peak for fluorescence microscopy volume rendering by using a neural network to analyze rendered frames, distinguishing itself by focusing on a single scalar parameter via image-space features rather than volume data properties.
